scope: External-historical sermon witness metadata, separate from 316 core first-party blog records and 19 supplemental publications

records.title: Erev Rosh Hashanah 5762 sermon after September 11 attacks (original title not verified)
records.event_date_basis: Author's 2026 retrospective explicitly dates Rosh Hashanah start September 17, 2001 and describes having delivered a replacement Erev Rosh Hashanah sermon that year
records.evidence_summary: Cohon retrospectively states that his originally planned Rosh Hashanah 2001 sermons were never delivered because of the September 11 attacks; he separately quotes an excerpt from the substitute Erev Rosh Hashanah sermon he actually delivered.
records.interpretation_boundary: A 2026 author-written self-quotation is evidence of words he retrospectively attributes to the delivered 2001 sermon; it is not a verified facsimile of the full original or confirmation that the precise excerpt matches a contemporaneous signed document. Undelivered drafts should never be counted as delivered sermons.
records.next_steps: If a 2001 Temple service transcript or original sermon manuscript appears, compare separately with the 2026 quotation, preserving original planned undelivered drafts versus delivered revised sermon.

calendar_corroboration.note: Matches the 2001 Erev Rosh Hashanah timing in Cohon's 2026 first-party retrospective. Does not independently document that a particular manuscript was delivered or authenticate the excerpt.
